short: A major British rebellion aimed at restoring the exiled Stuart dynasty to the throne.
full:
Following the accession of the Hanoverian King George I in 1714, Jacobite discontent surged across Britain. In September 1715, the Earl of Mar raised the standard for the exiled James Francis Edward Stuart at Braemar in Scotland, quickly gathering a substantial Highland army. Simultaneous uprisings were planned in England, but government forces suppressed them before they could gain momentum.

The rebellion culminated in the indecisive Battle of Sheriffmuir and the defeat of the English Jacobites at Preston. By the time James finally arrived in Scotland in December, the uprising was already collapsing. He fled back to France in February 1716, leaving his supporters to face execution, imprisonment, or exile, while the Hanoverian grip on the throne was firmly consolidated.
